podcast.body: This song was famously featured in the movie *Footloose*, blaring from Ren McCormick's VW bug radio in Beaumont. A young female fan described the song as being about "feeling crazy" in a mental institution setting, with a guy in a metal mask, ultimately symbolizing teenagers releasing their frustration. She praised its catchy lyrics for articulating feelings of wanting "more power" and "our own space," and it was noted for its loud, crunchy guitars. "The songs about feeling crazy the setting is a mental institution there's a guy running around in a metal mask and then the video cuts back to the band playing."

podcast.body: This song was one of the rock anthems that Adam Yauch and his friend Tom aimed to parody when composing the Beastie Boys' "(You Gotta) Fight For Your Right (To Party!)." "Adam Yacke and his buddy Tom wrote the song in response to rock songs like, I want a rock by twisted sister and bang your head from quiet riot."
